name: Johannesburg
tagline: Apartheid history, Soweto and Africa's art scene
summary: Johannesburg, or Jozi, is South Africa's energetic economic capital and the gateway to Kruger. Face the country's past at the Apartheid Museum and Constitution Hill, visit Mandela's house in Soweto, explore Maboneng's street art and Saturday markets, and see where humanity began at the Cradle of Humankind.
seasonNote: Autumn and spring are sunny and mild; summer brings afternoon thunderstorms.
arrival: O.R. Tambo International is 30 minutes away; the Gautrain runs to Sandton and Rosebank.
gettingAround: Gautrain and Uber; avoid walking at night.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work almost everywhere; carry small rand notes for car guards and tips.
foodTip: Braai (barbecue), bunny chow and Saturday market food.
buyTip: African art and design in Rosebank and Maboneng.

connections.note: Or a 1-hour flight to Skukuza or Nelspruit.
